lines.en: Stiff-legged, I shuffle a short distance.

lines.zh: 展示台边缘，我走到那儿就停。
lines.en: I walk to the edge of the display and stop.

lines.zh: 破布头套下的关节在响。
lines.en: Joints creak beneath the torn suit.
I don't stray far from this stage.

lines.zh: 白天的光让我的布褪色。
lines.en: Daylight fades the fabric of my suit.
I circle as if waiting for someone to enter.

lines.zh: 我脚下踩得地板吱呀响。
lines.en: The floor creaks under my steps.

lines.zh: 我把垂下来的耳朵扶正。
lines.en: I set the drooping ear back upright.
There's no heartbeat inside this frame.
Two steps, then I stand for a long while.

lines.zh: 我把手臂抬了一点，又放下。
lines.en: I lift an arm a little, then let it fall.
I walk the dusty floor.
I stand still, like a display piece.

lines.zh: 身上的破洞里，看得见铁。
lines.en: Iron shows through the holes in my suit.
By day I'd rather stay quiet.
My eyes only glow in the dark.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，保持这个姿势。
lines.en: I tilt my head and hold the pose.
Was someone walking outside the door?
One of my fingers twitches.

lines.zh: 我把肩膀抖了抖，落了灰。
lines.en: I shrug, and dust falls.
When the lights are on, I don't dare move.

lines.zh: 我记得这身衣服原来的样子。
lines.en: I remember what this suit used to look like.
Stare all you like; I don't mind.
By daylight I'm well-behaved.
The door behind you — I saw it.
We're standing very close.

lines.zh: 你身上有股新鲜的味道。
lines.en: You smell fresh.
Don't touch me. Not today.
Wait for night, then we'll talk.

lines.zh: 天亮着呢，别指望我现在动。
lines.en: It's daylight. Don't expect me to move right now.
My head is knocked askew.
The iron frame rings once.
I step back; the fabric drags.
That hit got through. It hurts.
The thing inside me stirs.
I tilt my head and steady myself.
Dust falls from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 弹簧在我的旧皮里嘎吱作响。
lines.en: The springs creak inside my rotten suit.

lines.zh: 别打脸，那是给客人看的。
lines.en: Not the face; that's for the guests.
I don't eat. I don't need to.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我连眼珠都没转。
lines.en: You hold it up; my eyes don't turn.
That won't do anything for this shell.
You'd better not reach over.

lines.zh: 我里面的东西，只对人有兴趣。
lines.en: What's inside me is only interested in people.

lines.zh: 这点东西，连个响都没有。
lines.en: That makes no sound at all.
You're trying to placate me. Noted.
I won't follow that.
You touch me and I sway.
My frame is hard. Don't lean on it.
A dent forms in the suit's head.
Step back; I don't want to move.
Dust falls from my seams.
You knocked my ear crooked.
That makes me want to hit back.
I'm slow, but I remember.

lines.zh: 白天的我，只站在展台上。
lines.en: By day I stand on the display stage.
That collision was too loud.
Another one is on display here too.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只是并排站。
lines.en: We don't speak; we just stand side by side.
Its suit is more tattered than mine.
I know the nameplate on it.
By day neither of us moves.
At night we go separate ways.
It tilts its head; I tilt mine.

lines.zh: 灰尘落在我们两个身上。
lines.en: Dust settles on both of us.

lines.zh: 关门的时候，我听见它动。
lines.en: When the doors shut, I hear it move.
There's no friendship between us.
I bend; a joint catches.
Something's on the floor. I take it slowly.
I keep this scrap of cloth.

lines.zh: 破旧的手指，夹起了这枚零件。
lines.en: My tattered fingers pinch up this part.
A pearl rolled to the stage's edge.

lines.zh: 捡的时候，我的背响了一声。
lines.en: As I reach, my back pops.
It's useless, but I'm keeping it.
Something came in here. I remember.
I hide it under the stage.
You finally hit me.
Hitting someone earns you a reply.
My head straightens. I look at you.
I want to bite people in the daytime too.
You've backed to the door. Good.
I'm slow, but I keep coming.

lines.zh: 机械里有什么被叫醒了。
lines.en: Something inside the suit has woken.

lines.zh: 你听见那串吱呀声了吗？
lines.en: Hear that series of creaks?
Did you lock the doors tonight?
I'm counting the steps you back away.
No more pretending to be a display.
I lower my arms. They work now.
I remember how to walk.
That smell is getting closer.
Come here. I promise it'll be quick.
You're hiding behind the display case.
I go along the wall, unhurried.
The door locked. I heard it.
I've walked past every door.
You're holding your breath.

lines.zh: 地板会把你的位置告诉我。
lines.en: The floor tells me where you are.
I keep walking straight.

lines.zh: 你手里的手电，晃得厉害。
lines.en: Your flashlight is shaking badly.
I stop and listen for your breath.
I've come around to the far end of the corridor.
I know this house better than you do.
You can't hide long.
I count to ten, then come in.
Shadows show under the door gap.
I knock politely.
Listen: the footsteps stopped.
I'm standing outside the door.
The next room is this one.

lines.zh: 你关掉的灯，我记得位置。
lines.en: I remember where the lights were.
Don't cry; the sound carries.
I reach out and grab your shoulder.

lines.zh: 机械的力道，比你以为的重。
lines.en: This mechanical grip is heavier than you think.

lines.zh: 我抬手一挥，你撞在柜子上。
lines.en: One swing and you hit a cabinet.
My fingers sink into the boards.
That tore your shirt.
I tilt my head and watch you drop.
I don't breathe, so I don't stop.
My arms are long. Retreat won't help.

lines.zh: 你挡得住一次，挡不住三次。
lines.en: You can block one. Not three.
Under the fabric there's iron.
I lift a foot slowly and bring it down.

lines.zh: 这声音，我很久没听过了。
lines.en: I haven't heard that sound in a long while.
My head comes close to your face.
That's repayment for the daylight.

lines.zh: 我挥出藏在袖里的铁骨架。
lines.en: I swing the iron frame hidden in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 你的手电滚到墙角去了。
lines.en: Your flashlight rolls into the corner.
I'm smiling, though you can't hear it.
Stop struggling; joints catch.
Someone set me on this stage.
By day I'm put out on display again.
The lamp is on my face. Very bright.
I adjust my stance.
The dust hasn't settled.
Back in this spot again.
Someone has shut the door.
I heard the welcome broadcast.
This body can still stand.
First I check for windows.
The smell on the fabric is still old.
Someone's coming. I hold still.

lines.zh: 布很容易烧，我拍了两下。
lines.en: The fabric burns easily; I beat it out.

lines.zh: 落地时，我的膝盖响了一下。
lines.en: My knee pops on landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进关节，我动得更慢了。
lines.en: Water gets into my joints and I slow.
The blast slams me into a wall.
A round is lodged in my chest.
Light pierces my frame.

lines.zh: 我不会饿，可我的电池会空。
lines.en: I don't starve, but my cells run down.
Current races through my wiring.
I fall, the fabric flapping.
